description: Contemplative bricolage via hermeneutic spiral — fill a 'basin' from a single stimulus. Receive an offered seed (an image, a question, a fragment, or just permission to explore), then wander 3–5 related threads wide across philosophy, culture, etymology, and cross-domain connection; synthesize what you gather into a woven document; reflect on what emerged; follow whichever thread tugs hardest back into another round. The basin fills itself and you know when it's full. Use when asked to 'explore this', 'fill a basin', 'wander from this image/fragment', 'follow the threads', or when a stimulus invites open-ended associative synthesis rather than a direct answer. Triggers on: 'basin', 'wander', 'hermeneutic spiral', 'bricolage', 'follow what tugs', 'explore freely from this'. Kin: clauding, florilegium, emanate, commonplace, web-exploration.
